title: Not sure if this is considered Mall World
content: I just found out about this, but I once had a dream were I was is a classroom and I knew I was in a dream and had to leave. I ran out of the classroom and teachers were trying to find me, there was one teacher who believed me and helped be escape. She brought me to a bathroom and I had to be flushed down the toilet to escape. I don't know what happened to the teacher in my dream. I don't know if this matters, but for details, she was a black woman with long black curls. I have never seen her before but she helped me escape my dream. The lighting in my dream was bluish and dark
